predecessors.name: Great Seljuk Empire
predecessors.text: Azerbaijan 'transferred to him as an iqta' in 1136 and Arran added in 1137

successors.name: Khwarazmian Empire
successors.text: Azerbaijan around Tabriz, taken 25 July 1225, and Arran

ledger.x: 1136: Sultan Mas'ud makes Shams ad-Din Eldiguz atabeg and grants him Azerbaijan.
1160: the atabeg controls the Seljuk sultan of Iraq.
1169: Rey is taken after Inanch's murder.
1174: Qizil Arslan captures Tabriz from the Ahmadilis.
1175: Pahlawan moves the capital from Nakhchivan to Hamadan.
1186: Qizil Arslan, who captured Tabriz in 1174, makes it his capital.
1191: war among the Eldiguzid possessions begins on Qizil Arslan's death (August or September 1191).
ledger.cp: Qutluq Inanj and Uzbek (sons of Inanj Khatun)

ledger.x: 1194: the Seljuk sultanate of Iraq ends.
1195: the dynastic war ends with Shamkor ('a dynastic war... from 1191 to 1195').
ledger.cp: Qutluq Inanj and Uzbek (sons of Inanj Khatun)

ledger.x: 1195: Shirvan leaves the atabeg's authority, at confidence 1: after Shamkor the Shirvanshah received Shamkor 'as a vassal' of the Georgians; the Shamkor infobox lists the Shirvanshahs on the Eldiguzid side while the Eldiguzids page says Akhsitan later allied with Georgia against Abu Bakr.
c. 1196: Abu Bakr regains his capital: 'lost his capital to a Georgian protégé. He regained it about a year later.'
1225: Jalal ad-Din takes Tabriz and deposes Uzbek.
1225: the Eldiguzid atabegate ends with the fall of Tabriz on 25 July.

wars.name: Georgian raids on Arran and Azerbaijan
wars.outcome: Georgian raids: Ganja's gate carried off in 1138 after an earthquake; Dvin (recovery attempt 1162); George III's march into Arran at the beginning of 1166 (the Eldiguzids page: reaching Nakhchivan and Beylagan, then an armistice with Ani returned to the…

wars.name: Eldiguzid war with the Seljuk sultan Toghrul III
wars.outcome: Toghrul III was seized by Qizil Arslan's men in 1190, overthrown in 1191, restored in 1192 and, in 1194, 'after a long war with the Khwarazm Shahs', defeated, ending the Seljuk sultanate of Iraq.

wars.name: Battle of Shamkor
wars.outcome: Georgian victory over Abu Bakr on 1 June 1195; Shamkor and Ganja fell to the Georgians; Shamkor and surroundings were given to Shirvanshah Amir Mihran.

wars.name: Khwarazmian conquest of Tabriz
wars.outcome: Jalal ad-Din took Tabriz on 25 July 1225 and deposed Uzbek (the khwarezmid-empire dossier has the 1217 vassalage that preceded it).

certainty.note: Provincial extents (Azerbaijan, Arran) rather than surveyed frontiers; the Georgian frontier moved with each raid and the Shirvan, Persian Iraq and Ahmadili frontiers are approximate.
